clips.title: The story
paras: The Balnir Farmstead is a derelict estate in eastern Tirisfal Glades, northeast of the Ruins of Lordaeron. Once a working farm of the Balnir family, the lands now lie ruined and infested by wandering Scourge that slip past the Bulwark.

For generations, the Balnir family worked their homestead in the rolling hills of eastern Tirisfal, and their garden of snapdragons still blooms among the ruins. When the Scourge swept through Lordaeron during the Third War, the farm was overrun and its people lost, leaving the buildings to rot.
